user.title: Music Light Synk
user.description: Your lights follow the album art playing on your Fire TV / Android TV. The webhook ID must match the one set in the TV app (the app uses music_light_synk by default). If the Music Light Synk blueprint already uses that ID, either delete that automation first or pick another ID here and add it to the app.

data_description.name: E.g. Living room TV. Used for the device and entity names.

lights.title: Which lights follow which part of the artwork?
lights.description: Pick lights for any zones you like and leave the rest empty. Everything else (brightness, WLED effects, what happens when the music stops) is under Configure afterwards.

data_description.dominant_lights: Best choice if you only have one or two lights.
data_description.vibrant_lights: The most colourful part of the artwork.

tv.title: Control the TV app from Home Assistant (optional)
tv.description: Pick your Fire TV / Android TV entity from Home Assistant's Android Debug Bridge integration. Then the device gets controls for the colour source (album art or screen capture), screen capture, WLED, and every other TV app setting. Skip this if you don't use the Android Debug Bridge integration.

error.webhook_in_use: This webhook ID is already in use (probably by the blueprint automation). Delete that automation or pick another ID.

abort.already_configured: This webhook ID is already set up

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Which lights follow which part of the artwork. Leave a zone empty to skip it.

data_description.dominant_lights: Best choice if you only have one or two lights.
data_description.vibrant_lights: The most colourful part of the artwork.

data_description.max_brightness: Scales the artwork brightness down, e.g. 60 % for a cosy room.
data_description.transition: Many Tuya bulbs ignore fades; 0 is fine for them.

data_description.effect_mode: Lights without effects (e.g. most Tuya bulbs) are never sent an effect.
data_description.effect_name: Used with 'Run an effect'. Pick one or type any name your light lists; lights without it get a solid colour.
data_description.palette_selects: Optional. Many WLED effects use their own palette; these selects are switched to the option below while an effect runs, and restored on stop.

data_description.on_stop: The TV app reports 'stopped' after playback has been paused for the delay set in the app (15 s by default).

tv.name: TV app control
tv.description: The Fire TV / Android TV entity from the Android Debug Bridge integration. Used to change the TV app's settings from Home Assistant.

options.follow: Follow the artwork (dark art = dim lights)

options.solid: Solid colour - stop any running effect (recommended)
options.effect: Run an effect in the artwork colours

options.restore: Restore the lights to how they were before the music

state.auto: Auto: album art, screen if no art
